ApprovalCandidate.title: ApprovalCandidate

ArmMeasurement.title: ArmMeasurement

ColumnStats.title: ColumnStats

QueryFingerprint.title: QueryFingerprint

A new LLM run on the same inputs (REPLAY_ENGINE §1 "AI re-investigation"). The flag is
the caller's explicit consent to new model calls: replays never make any.
ReinvestigateRequest.title: ReinvestigateRequest

ReportOut.description: The stored, digest-verified report JSON plus its version axes (REPLAY_ENGINE §7).
ReportOut.title: ReportOut

(equal, or inconclusive after a downgrade), the deterministic checks and the review.

get.description: Exact stored bytes, re-verified against the digest on read.

post.description:
Revokes the session server-side and clears both cookies. Needs the CSRF token like any
mutation, so another site cannot sign a user out. Idempotent.

`confirm_ddl` is the user's confirmation of the exact SQL: it becomes the replay run's
approval. A failed precondition is recorded as a `not_replayable` attempt and answered 422
with `details.code` and `details.replay_attempt_id` (no run is created).

With an `Idempotency-Key` (UUID), a repeat of the same request by the same user returns the
original attempt (also a repeated 422), whatever happened since; concurrent duplicates
converge on one attempt through a unique index; the same key with a different request is
409 `IDEMPOTENCY_CONFLICT`. Keys are scoped to the user and this operation and kept with
the attempt (at least the 24 h API_DESIGN promises).

get.description: Liveness only: the process is up.

post.description:
New `reinvestigation` run on the same inputs, with its own budget and provenance and a
link to the run it re-investigates. The conclusion diff is Post-MVP (REPLAY_ENGINE §10).

get.description: Readiness: metadata DB reachable and migrated to head (API_DESIGN §2).

post.description:
Idempotent (API_DESIGN §4): queued/awaiting_approval stop at once; a running run moves
to cancelling and the worker stops at its next safe point.

get.description: Both plans must be plan artifacts of this run (uploaded, live EXPLAIN or experiment).

post.description: Synchronous verification; the attempt row records the result (REPLAY_ENGINE §8.1).

get.description: `report` is the stored report JSON; `export` carries the manifest digest.
Stored Markdown plus an export footer (manifest digest, run ID, how to verify).
The Benchmark Auditor's verdicts for this run, in round and candidate order.

post.description:
Stores the user's own key encrypted (ADR-0012), replacing any earlier key for the same
provider. The response, logs and errors show only the last 4 characters.

delete.description:
Soft-deletes the row and wipes the ciphertext in the same statement. Runs that were
started with it stop at their next resume with CONFIGURATION_ERROR.

get.description:
Which provider/model runs use, and whether a key exists (the user's own, or the local
profile's server key). Never the key.
